items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: FR-01.28/FR-01.66: desktop still hides dead links (waits for probe); coarse pointer answers from cache so the first tap opens; V4 server rule untouched.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Unknown/failed probe stays a link (fail-open, as before); background probe never rejects.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: Client-only; activation still goes through resolveViewerTarget + isRefusedBySession + server access rules.

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: New unit test for the optimistic path; spec 106 stale test rewritten to assert probe verdicts via the real route plus no link/notice/viewer on click; phone test now passes on first tap.

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Optimistic path does no awaiting; probes batched/cached as before.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: One optional param on probeTerminalRefs; reuses COARSE_POINTER_QUERY.
